transcript: Last night I went to see The Comeuppance, a new play by Brandon Jacobs Jenkins at Signature Theater. The premise is a small group of friends meeting up to pregame their 20th anniversary high school reunion. Some of them haven't seen one another in many years, and as you might expect, they don't really seem to have much in common anymore. It's hard to connect without just laboring over the past, and awkward conversations quickly turn sour as old skeletons are brought out, so to speak. Office play was really good, and the writing and performances just felt so accurate and so believable. The whole play, which takes place on the front porch of one of the characters homes, is riddled with tension, which really kept me engaged the entire time despite it being over 2 hours with no intermission. It also had some fun stage magic. Anyway, I would definitely recommend with that. Another program for my collection.
